best_idea: A zone spawn director that makes at most one spawn per timer fire, pauses its timer while full, re-arms on removal, and for presence zones triggers only when empty and off cooldown.
decision_why: Keep the park-when-full timer, one spawn per fire, weighted entry pick and empty-plus-cooldown presence gate; start the cooldown at the despawn with a grace timer as row 23 requires, not at the trigger; group refill-after-wipe only as an optional zone flag.
acceptance: Server test on a zone with cap 3 and respawn 5 to 10 s: killing all three wolves empties the zone; a fourth wolf never appears while three are alive; the timer does not run while the zone is full; a player stepping into range of an empty zone gets one spawn, only after the cooldown has elapsed.
